summary: Harden status JSON overflow/surrogates, inode/ancestor symlinks, and subject projection collisions

delivery.outcome: Enforce \A...\Z regex anchors, 10**400 JSON integer overflow and lone UTF-16 surrogate rejection, positive integer max_bytes plus symlink-ancestor and lstat/fstat inode identity checks in read_regular_bytes, ASCII control-character and '|' projection-key collision guards in validate_stream, sync profiles/dsl-manifest.json digest, expand standard/test_status_hardening.py, and mark merged ticket-007 DONE.
nonGoals: No breaking changes to valid status streams or status.json documents

architecture.decision: Harden JSON tree validation, regular-file inode/ancestor verification, and identifier/projection separator rules directly in standard/status_check.py, sync its parser-contract sha256 in profiles/dsl-manifest.json, and cover adversarial regressions in standard/test_status_hardening.py.
architecture.rollback: Revert the ticket-008 commit or close the pull request before merge.
